summary: Last in-route lift: 20 outer folds, 5 inner folds, same grid — then threshold or honest plateau
reasoning: Observation step-20 contradicted the 10-fold run (0.7937 < 0.80). Pilot diagnostics (step-23) explain it: 6 noise dims dilute Euclidean distances; no in-route feature lever exists. The remaining honest lever is estimation data-efficiency, already shown to move the estimate (5->10 folds: +0.009): go to 20 outer folds (train on 950/1000, closer to the deployed 1000-row model) with 5 inner folds (180-row inner tests, stabler k selection). Both are protocol choices decided on pilot evidence, not seed shopping; the model family, features and tuning set {k, weights} are untouched. Runtime ~2400 tiny single-threaded fits. If cv_auc >= 0.80, proceed to the single final holdout run; if it misses again, the route's plateau is declared honestly and heldout stays sealed.
